title: What's New: Manufacturing Analytics (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: PowerBI app improvements and capacity units
Updated and new reports released in version 27.0

features.name: PowerBI app for manufacturing
features.description: Updated PowerBI app that addresses feedback from business scenarios. Now shows all capacity-related measures in a universal unit of measure chosen in Business Central manufacturing setup, making it easier to spot production issues and reduce waste.
caveats: PowerBI app should be installed or updated separately from built-in reports

features.name: Excel layouts for manufacturing reports
features.description: Manufacturing and analytics reports now offer Excel layout options in addition to legacy layouts. Excel layouts enable end users to analyze data, change layout, filter, sort, and customize reports without requiring customization.
caveats: Word layouts also available but focus in demo is on Excel

features.name: In-client help and teaching tips for reports
features.description: Manufacturing reports now include teaching tips when opening request pages, and an in-client help pane that provides information about each report with links to Microsoft Learn documentation articles.
caveats: Teaching tips do not need to be enabled everywhere

features.name: Manufacturing reports with modernized layouts
features.description: Six updated manufacturing reports and two completely new reports were modernized with Excel and Word layouts. These include Where Used (Top Level), Quantity Explosion of Bill of Material, and Production Order List. Delayed from 26.2 to ship in version 27.0.
caveats: Three additional reports mentioned beyond the originally planned eight

features.name: Manufacturing analytics landing page
features.description: A comprehensive landing page (aka.ms/bc-manufacturing-analytics) covering manufacturing analytics with personas, use cases, and resources for analyzing production data.
